detailed_description: The Pictorial Bar Chart Generator builds an ECharts pictorial bar chart from editable category and value rows. You can load sample data, add or delete rows, choose from built-in symbol shapes, switch color themes, set a chart title, toggle horizontal layout and legend display, and preview the chart in the browser. The finished chart can be downloaded as PNG or SVG.
usage_steps: Start from the default rows or click Load Sample to reset the sample chart.
Edit category names and numeric values in the data table.
Choose a symbol shape, color theme, chart title, horizontal layout, and legend setting.
Preview the chart and download it as PNG or SVG.
usage_examples: Example 1: Create a quick visual comparison of product counts using repeated rounded-rectangle symbols.
Example 2: Build a classroom chart with categories and values to make a simple dataset easier to scan.
Example 3: Try different built-in symbol shapes such as circle, diamond, triangle, arrow, or pin before exporting.
Example 4: Download a pictorial bar chart as PNG or SVG for a presentation, report, or article.
